title: Taste's Lemony Salmon Pasta
steps: Cook fettuccine in boiling salted water until al dente, reserving 60ml of the cooking liquid before draining.
Cook salmon in a large frying pan over medium heat for 3 minutes per side, then rest for 5 minutes.
Heat oil in the same pan over medium-low heat and cook the sliced leek for 3 minutes until softened.
Add garlic, zucchini ribbons, and lemon zest to the pan, cooking for 2 minutes until the zucchini softens.
Stir in lemon juice, dill, peas, cooked pasta, reserved liquid, and ricotta, tossing gently to combine.
Flake the rested salmon into the pasta mixture, season to taste, and serve immediately with crusty bread.
